item.title: Can a student ID be used for voting? More Republican-led states are banning it
item.description: New bans on student IDs for voting in Indiana and New Hampshire have led to lawsuits, creating new hurdles for voters.

item.title: Car problems? No childcare? How an app is helping people get to work
item.description: Unexpected absences can cost employers thousands monthly. An app assists workers with last-minute transportation, food, and childcare.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, known for 'Heroes' and 'Nashville,' dies at 36
item.description: Starting as an infant in commercials, Panettiere gained fame as country star Juliette in 'Nashville' and as Claire in 'Heroes.'

item.title: Living with nuns: Young women find affordable housing in D.C.
item.description: For a decade, a Catholic-run residence provided low-cost housing for young women in Washington, D.C., as they pursued education and careers. Now, the program is ending.
